+> - `README.md` — no validator matches this file
+
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/RedriveInterruptedRunsProcessTests.swift:121` `reuse/reuse` — The teardown of a NestedRootSession is written out inline here. The prompt cancel and the connection close repeat what `quit` does in SubagentSessionsTests, so the teardown sequence now lives in two places. Add a teardown method to NestedRootSession, for example `closeClientSide()`, that cancels the prompt and closes the connection. Call it from `quit` and from `recordInterruptedRun`. The kill step stays where it is.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:91` `reuse/reuse` — The gate path is built by hand with `makeResolvedDirectory(...).appendingPathComponent("never")`. The same construction is written inline in RedriveInterruptedRunsProcessTests.swift:95, so the gate convention is repeated in two places rather than kept in one helper. Add one helper, for example `NestedAgentFixture.gateFile(label:)`, that returns the never-opening gate URL. Call it from both suites.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:142` `reuse/reuse` — `leafIsWorking` looks up the child of the root and then the leaf of that child with a guard. The same pair of `firstChild(of:)` lookups is written again in the settle predicate of `runFinishedChain` (line 176), and again at lines 291-292 in `runWorkingChain`. The chain lookup is repeated instead of kept in one helper. Add one helper on `[WireTraceEvent]`, for example `chain(of root:) -> (child: SessionId, leaf: SessionId)?`, built on `firstChild(of:)`. Use it in `leafIsWorking`, the settle predicate of `runFinishedChain`, and `runWorkingChain`.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:260` `reuse/reuse` — `WorkingChain` has the same fields as `FinishedChain` at line 149 (session, trace, child, leaf). Two result types with the same shape can drift apart and need the same change in two places. Use one chain result struct for both the finished and the working chain. Both helpers return it.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:307` `completeness/public-output-contract` — The refusal test for a child's session/prompt accepts any error. The test does not check the error code or id that the refusal sends. A prompt that fails for another reason, such as a transport error or a crash, would also pass. The refusal contract is therefore not proven. The same weakness applies to the session/close check on line 308. Assert the specific refusal error (its JSON-RPC code or message) for both `prompt` and `closeSession` on the child id. Keep the existing assertion that the root session still works.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:307` `test-integrity/no-test-cheating` — The refusal check accepts any error, not the refusal the test name describes. A transport close, a crash or an unrelated failure also passes, so the test does not prove the child refuses `session/prompt`. Assert the specific error that the agent returns for a refused method, for example the JSON-RPC method-not-permitted code or a message match, so an unrelated failure fails the test.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:308` `test-integrity/no-test-cheating` — The refused-close check accepts any error, so a close that fails for an unrelated reason passes as a refusal. Assert the specific refusal error code or message for `session/close` on a child, as in the prompt check.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/SubagentSessionsTests.swift:396` `reuse/reuse` — The private static `resume` reimplements the cold-resume driver that already exists as `resume(recording:)` in RedriveInterruptedRunsProcessTests. Both spawn a SpawnedACPAgent, connect, initialize, subscribe, call readResumeTrace, then close the connection and stdin. The only real differences are the script and the `replayFrom` field. Two copies will drift apart, for example when the timeout or the close order changes in one of them. Extract one shared resume helper into NestedAgentFixture or a support file. Parameterize it by the script, the workspace and config home, the resume request (with or without `replayFrom`), and the settle predicate. Both suites then call it.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/Support/LiveTraceReading.swift:100` `reuse/reuse` — `isCancelledIdle(of:)` is a near-match of `isIdle(of:)` at line 89. It repeats the same stream check and `stateUpdate` extraction, and differs only by the stop reason. The right move was to parameterize `isIdle` by an optional stop reason instead of writing a parallel copy. Replace both with one function, for example `isIdle(of:stopReason:)`, where the stop reason defaults to nil and the check compares it when given. Keep the existing call sites working through a thin wrapper, or update them.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/Support/NestedAgentFixture.swift:49` `reuse/reuse` — `isCompletedCall` rewrites the `.update(stream, .toolCallUpdate(call))` pattern match by hand. The same extension already has the `stream` and `sessionUpdate` accessors, and `isToolCall(on:)` in LiveTraceReading.swift uses them. Each new copy of the pattern is another place to change if the update shape changes. Write it as `stream == session, case .toolCallUpdate(let call)? = sessionUpdate, call.toolCallId == id, call.status == .value(.completed)`, using the existing accessors.
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentIntegrationTests/Support/NestedRootSession.swift:42` `reuse/reuse` — The spawn, connect and initialize sequence is written out again here. Extract a helper that spawns the agent, connects the model and initializes it, and returns those values. `NestedRootSession.start` and both `resume` helpers call it. `start` then adds only the new session.
